# `decision` attributes

**Attributes:**

| Key | Stability | Value Type | Description | Example Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="decision-model-name" href="#decision-model-name">`decision.model_name`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | string | The name of the decision model being utilized. Mirrors `llm.model_name` for `DECISION` spans. | `jev-1.13.0` |
| <a id="decision-provider" href="#decision-provider">`decision.provider`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | string (well-known values) | The hosting provider of the decision model: who runs the hardware that answered, e.g. `typesafe` when calling TypeSafe directly, `openai` for the OpenAI Decisions API, or the cloud or self-hosting provider for a model served elsewhere. Distinct from `decision.system`, which names the API shape. The well-known values alias the matching `llm.provider` values. | `typesafe` |
| <a id="decision-request-model-name" href="#decision-request-model-name">`decision.request.model_name`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | string | The decision model requested by the caller, as sent in the request. May differ from `decision.response.model_name` when the provider resolves an alias or routes the request. | `jev-latest` |
| <a id="decision-response-model-name" href="#decision-response-model-name">`decision.response.model_name`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | string | The decision model that actually produced the response, as reported by the provider. May differ from `decision.request.model_name`. | `jev-1.13.0` |
| <a id="decision-system" href="#decision-system">`decision.system`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | string (well-known values) | The decision API ecosystem the call conforms to, i.e. which request/response shape the client speaks, as identified by the client or server instrumentation: `typesafe` for the TypeSafe System One / Jev API, `openai` for the OpenAI Decisions API. A self-hosted vLLM server answering the Jev-compatible `/v1/systemone` shape is still `typesafe`. Distinct from `decision.provider`, which says who hosts the model. The well-known values alias the matching `llm.system` values. | `typesafe` |
| <a id="decision-token-count-input" href="#decision-token-count-input">`decision.token_count.input`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | int | The number of input tokens consumed by a decision model call: the state, questions, and candidate options. Maps to `usage.input_tokens` in TypeSafe System One responses. | `412` |
| <a id="decision-token-count-output" href="#decision-token-count-output">`decision.token_count.output`</a> | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) | int | The number of output tokens produced by a decision model call. Decision models emit typed answers rather than text, so this is typically small. Maps to `usage.output_tokens` in TypeSafe System One responses. | `2` |

`decision.provider` has the following list of well-known values. If one of them applies, then the respective value MUST be used; otherwise, a custom value MAY be used.

| Value | Description | Stability |
| --- | --- | --- |

| `openai` | OpenAI | ![Development](https://img.shields.io/badge/-development-blue) |
